Locked-off camera, framing holds. The man in front takes two firm steps toward the camera, gun held straight up at the ceiling. The gang behind him follows at a walk. The glass fragments in the air drift down and settle on the marble. The bystanders keep crouching and shielding themselves. Dust turns slowly in the sunlight. Masks stay exactly as they are. SFX: tinkling glass landing, heavy footsteps. Ambient noise: a large echoing hall.
